Query: grasp the brown tape to place the marker.
Planner: move to 5cm on top of the marker

affordable.observe: Releasing the object does not require new affordance, so default is used.

avoid.observe: No special obstacle processing is required when opening the gripper, so default avoidance is used.

gripper.observe: Opening the gripper is represented by setting all voxels of the gripper map to 0.

rotation.observe: Releasing the brown tape does not require orientation change, so rotation remains default.
